svg.title: Decorator
svg.desc: Decorator. Wrap an object to add behaviour at runtime, stacking wrappers instead of multiplying subclasses for every combination. Step 1, A subclass per combination: Features as subclasses: 3 features already need 7 classes, and each mix is fixed at compile time. Step 2, Wrap instead: Each decorator implements HttpClient and wraps another one; nest them at runtime like an onion. Step 3, One call, layer by layer: send(GET /orders) passes each layer; the 503 is retried after 200 ms, and the log gets 2 lines. Step 4, Order matters: Swap the order: logging now sits inside the retry and sees every attempt, so the log gets 4 lines.

g.text: Features as subclasses: 3 features already need 7 classes, and each mix is fixed at compile time.
Each decorator implements HttpClient and wraps another one; nest them at runtime like an onion.
send(GET /orders) passes each layer; the 503 is retried after 200 ms, and the log gets 2 lines.
Swap the order: logging now sits inside the retry and sees every attempt, so the log gets 4 lines.
mix and order fixed at compile time
3 features → 3 small classes: any mix, any order, chosen at runtime
the 503 stops at RetryingClient: LoggingClient and the caller never see it
out of process: a sidecar proxy adds retries + TLS
